🌟 Interlace | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To accelerate and scale the execution of single-threaded command-line tools, particularly in security and network enumeration tasks, by allowing them to run concurrently against a large number of targets defined using CIDR or glob patterns.
✨ Key Features: • Multi-threading for command-line applications • CIDR notation support for targets • Glob support for targets • Exclusion lists for targets • Customizable thread count and timeouts
📖 Summary: Interlace is a Python-based tool designed to enhance single-threaded command-line applications by enabling multi-threading. It simplifies the process of running these applications concurrently against multiple targets, supporting CIDR notation for IP ranges and glob patterns for file matching.
